title: Archive a cf6a-based nine-swap WORD with finite replay and a conditional invoice crossing
body:
## Result and exact scope
This package supplies a nine-swap cf6a descendant, canonical WORD `ae62d5d8bef6f7146454b4b3643e487a58380c606a16c5baef7bf0dcf9df1472`, and a standalone replay of its normalized finite semantics. The 154768-event WORD has 235 CLEARs (42 zero) and peak 51 owned fields. All 148154 rational literals satisfy the stated 24-bit/smoothness rules.

Directed 256-bit comparison of the supplied invoice brackets its conditional crossing between κ=0.00372934317806 (new cost lower) and κ=0.00372934317807 (new cost higher). This is an invoice result, not complete physical admission or an unconditional multiplication bound. The inherited framework assumptions remain.

## Source, task and added value
Base: main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. The supplier-boundary-audit task is explicitly refined, with outcome partial: provide a concrete supplied object, exact finite checks and clearly separated remaining obligations. The change is confined to `research/cf6a-nine-swap-supplied-word/`; no shared checker, selected record, workflow or predecessor is changed.

This is a cf6a/K3724 composition of nine reselected relaxed swaps, not R2 plus one, under #7663's changed helper contract. #7658/#7641 provide swap lineage. #7682's role230 reroute is not included and is a separate banked-DAG family, not a same-contract numerical comparator. Exact input hashes bind the supplied example and source copies, not eligibility gates for other candidates.

## Reproduction and tests
From the repository root:

    python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/cf6a-nine-swap-supplied-word

Python 3.12 standard library only. The original portable package passed on Mac 3.9.6 and an independent fresh Linux 3.12.14 extraction of the archive. The integrated package was separately run on Linux 3.12.14: all four commands returned 0, all children were reaped, and the registered outcome was partial.

The finite replay checks intended normalized forward rows, all CLEAR certificates, chart/lifetime legality, actual base-WORD full header binding and literal legality. Three controls reject a self-referential CLEAR, deletion of a dirty CLEAR relation, and denominator 7 with the exact expected error, rather than treating a crash as success. Two price commands verify the stated endpoint signs.

This runs unchanged, separately written finite and price engines, **not upstream original check.py, the live constructor, the full native catalogue or the selected-framework cold replay**. Enlarged-grid, selected 12-edge native, ordinary 735415392, precision c=1344, physical binding and caller/invoice derivation receipts are retained but reused, not freshly established.

## Construction and physical limits
Construction regeneration is NOT_ESTABLISHED: nine labels do not freeze final JointNewton coefficients or the complete generating closure. The supplied WORD is reproducibly checked, but its generation from seeds/build inputs is not reproduced. A live scratch-dependent builder is not presented as a reproducible recipe.

The full rounded 16-call execution, coherent MOVE/CLEAR, compiler/tape realization, paid owned reset, supplier extent/common-U, tariffs and analytic recovery remain open. Exact linear recovery is not physical erasure. Header equality is not a complete provider contract.

## Credit and packaging
Credit DreamingOfClouds #7641/#7658, Ali Romman #7663, SYLforge predecessors, Rohan Arun #7113-derived separate caller and the original evaluator/invoice authors. Source licenses, notices and citation metadata are retained unchanged. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance is disclosed; no specific per-turn model attribution, human review or formal-kernel proof is claimed.

All 31 retained source inputs and both scientific runners are byte-identical to the private source package. Derived inventories remove machine-specific locations and explicitly record omissions. Duplicate/empty inputs and unnecessary operational logs are excluded, with reasons and hashes; original private receipts remain unchanged. The package includes structured Open next questions for freezing generation and establishing actual rounded/physical supplier admission.

## CI boundary
Private registered replay and metadata checks pass. The unchanged base has a known CI navigation mismatch (frontier6030 in documentation versus selected frontier7000); this package does not repair shared code. No hosted CI result is claimed.

This partial source-bound contribution does not change the selected frontier.
